## Level-Up Flow

**When offered:** The Worker decides via `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`worker/src/services/character.ts:159`) — true when `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level]` and `level < 10`. Thresholds (`worker/src/types/index.ts:175`): 0, 300, 900, 2700, 6500, 14000, 23000, 34000, 48000, 64000. This `canLevelUp` flag is returned from `POST /api/action` (`routes/action.ts:99`) and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/combat.ts:109`). The frontend pre-computes it locally in `CharacterStateService.checkLevelUp` (`character-state.service.ts:52,76`) but overwrites with the server value (`game-console.component.ts:128,155`). UI shows a banner (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) and an ability picker (`game-console.component.html:19-28`).

**Endpoint:** User picks an ability → `game-console.component.ts:183` `levelUp(key)` → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → `POST /api/levelup` (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). Ability choice must be one of str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; returns 400 if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- `level` +1
- HP gain = roll(class hit die) + CON modifier, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- Chosen ability score **+2** (no cap at 20; AC unchanged)
- One level per call — a character with enough XP for 2 levels needs 2 calls

Response also includes flavor text (`generateLevelUpNarrative`, usually fallback per bug B-03), a `system` log row `[Level Up] …`, and a DM history turn. Frontend then calls `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, posts a system message, and updates the campaign slot level.
